Strait of Hormuz · Daily brief · UTC
16 October 2026 .
Brent $ 105.77 + 0.45 % · Transits 2 (2026-10-11) · AI-assisted
01 CBS News and FreightWaves warn ships in the Strait of Hormuz still face indiscriminate attacks, with container vessel strikes escalating.

02 Iranian state media claim another oil tanker caught fire east of the strait after entering a prohibited area; no maritime authority has confirmed this.

03 Brent stood at $105.77, up 0.45% over 24 hours, as of 15:12 UTC; IMF PortWatch recorded 2 transits on October 11, against a pre-crisis baseline of 85 per day.

Situation
The Strait of Hormuz remains a contested and dangerous waterway. CBS News warns that ships still face indiscriminate attacks, and FreightWaves reports container vessel strikes are escalating, with WWD reporting two ships have sunk near the strait as attacks on container vessels intensify. Iranian state media claim, without confirmation from any maritime authority, that Iran's navy detected an oil tanker on fire east of the strait after it entered a prohibited area while allegedly non-compliant. L'Orient Today and Awani International carry the same claim, which originates with Iranian state media. The closure and attack tempo continue to suppress transits: IMF PortWatch recorded 2 vessel crossings on October 11, compared with a pre-crisis baseline of 85 per day. Brent crude was at $105.77, up 0.45% over 24 hours, as of 15:12 UTC. The feed indexed 71 headlines in the past 24 hours. WANA News Agency reports the strait will remain closed until Iran's rights are respected, a claim the site cannot independently assess. As of 15:22 UTC, 152 AIS-visible vessels were holding position away from berth in the Strait of Hormuz and Gulf watch box, a count that leaves out ships within 25km of a working port. On the Hormuz Index, Crisis Pressure, the state composite, sits in the extreme band, flat over 24 hours, with its value set by physical transit deviation alone; the Escalation Forecast sits in the high band, flat over 24 hours, with the Brent-WTI forward spread as its top contributor.

Recorded
Brent up 3.3% in 24h
